answer: In PoA, each agent’s EigenTrust-derived reputation is updated from signed peer evaluations, reciprocity-weighted transitivity, and matrix-factorized trust; its contribution decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so honest service must be sustained rather than briefly manufactured.
